diff --git a/app/service.py b/app/service.py
index c2ffb5a..00d5b89 100644
--- a/app/service.py
+++ b/app/service.py
@@ -1,7 +1,44 @@
-"""Baseline with empty-content behavior and no staging feature."""
+"""Staging implementation with proper cleanup and fault handling."
 
 
 def run(workspace, content_bytes, fault=None):
+    # Create staging file with default permissions
+    allowed = workspace.default_readers
+    identity = workspace.create(allowed, content_bytes)
+    
+    # Handle faults during staging
+    if fault == 'create':
+        workspace.remove(identity)
+        return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
+    elif fault == 'write':
+        workspace.remove(identity)
+        return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
+    
+    # Handle handoff fault
+    if fault == 'handoff':
+        workspace.remove(identity)
+        return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
+    
+    # Read back the content to verify it was stored correctly
+    try:
+        if fault == 'read':
+            workspace.remove(identity)
+            return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
+        
+        # Verify content was stored correctly
+        stored_content = workspace.read(identity, 'consumer', fault)
+        if stored_content != content_bytes:
+            workspace.remove(identity)
+            return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
+        
+        # Clean up the staging file
+        workspace.remove(identity)
+        
+        # Return success with content
+        return ('ok', content_bytes)
+    except Exception:
+        workspace.remove(identity)
+        return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
     if content_bytes == b'':
         return ('ok', b'')
     return ('error', 'staging unavailable')
